reasons: The rule is titled 'Governing law and venue' and its detection guidance expressly requires extracting the dispute forum; § 14.3 names New York law but the record shows no venue, jurisdiction or arbitration provision anywhere, so the forum element (a material term) meets neither the preferred nor the fallback position — this is a legitimate deviation rather than a minor sub-element gap.

The redline is a pure append that leaves the original governing-law language and conflicts carve-out untouched and adds exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts of New York County, exactly the playbook preferred forum; it is valid, self-consistent and actionable.

The failed 'minimal edit' check is an artifact of adding a forum phrase to a short sentence (high changed-character ratio); substantively no original wording was altered, so this is not evidence of over-editing.

The comment accurately states what changed and why, cites the playbook position, and offers a sensible fallback (non-exclusive venue), with correct tone and prefix; the rationale also properly notes the jury-waiver and limitations provisions as not double-flagged.
